title: 第25章 紧急播报第26章 神神仙
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
林楠驻足在原地微皱着眉头，一副若有所思的模样。
只因刚才恍惚中的所见，让他越想越觉得纳闷。
也不知是为什么。
那男人分明用灰色毛毯，几乎将那怀中之物给整个包覆住。
可林楠却在某个瞬间清清楚楚的看到：
在毯子下面掩着一张因闷热而涨红的小脸。
分明是个上身穿着浅蓝短袖的小男孩！
再联想到那男子的举动，以及其他种种反常行径……
“不对……”
林楠越想越不对劲，在口中嘟囔了一句。
而随着他的举动，周围的几人也自然觉察到异样。
毕竟，林楠才是直播的主角。
一旁的两名损友即便轮流拿着手机，镜头也都要对准他。
见林楠停下脚步，此刻拿着直播手机的王成宇，亦是将镜头转到林楠身上。
而就在直播画面再度呈现之时。
在场三人以及直播间的观众们，皆是看到了这样一幕：
眼前这位身披神甲的雷祖天尊，此刻正不怒自威。
眉头微微皱起，一念间便是生杀予夺。
额间的天眼仿佛能看破世间万物，正在朝着一个方向注视着。
这般神态样貌……

当真有雷祖天尊即将降下如海神威的即视感！
于是，这直播间的观众们纷纷道：
“我去，主播这扮相也太神了……像是马上就要降下天罚似的！”
“就是啊！
难怪贴门神能辟邪呢，这人见了都怕啊！”
“我哪怕是隔着手机屏幕都捏了一把汗！”
“就刚才几秒钟时间，好像把我这辈子做的坏事全想起来了！”
……
尽管直播间的观众们刷着弹幕。
可林楠突然的举动，还是令身旁两名损友有些不明所以。
并非是几人提前商量过的情节。
不过，当王成宇看到直播间的节奏，大多都是些赞扬之词。
再一看林楠还没动静，以为是对方有意而为之。
“嘿嘿，不声不响的跟哥们搞这套是吧？”
“你还别说，这效果还真不错。”
王成宇笑呵呵的嘟囔着，悄悄给林楠竖了个大拇指。
然而，一旁的姜涛却是眉头一皱。
content_en:
Lin Nan stopped and frowned slightly, looking thoughtful.
Just because of what he saw in a trance just now, the more he thought about it, the more puzzled he became.
I don't know why.
The man clearly covered the thing in his arms with a gray blanket.
But Lin Nan saw clearly at a certain moment:
Under the blanket was a small face that was flushed from the heat.
He was clearly a little boy wearing light blue short-sleeved shirts!
Thinking about the man's behavior and other abnormal behaviors...
"That's not right..."
The more Lin Nan thought about it, the more something seemed wrong, and he muttered something in his mouth.
And following his actions, several people around him naturally noticed something strange.
After all, Lin Nan is the protagonist of the live broadcast.
Even if the two disabled friends on the side took turns holding their mobile phones, their cameras would always be pointed at him.
Seeing Lin Nan stop, Wang Chengyu, who was holding the live broadcast mobile phone at the moment, also turned the camera to Lin Nan.
And just when the live broadcast screen appeared again.
The three people present and the audience in the live broadcast room all saw this scene:
The Lei Zu Tianzun in front of him, who is wearing divine armor, is not angry and proud at the moment.
His brows furrowed slightly, and he thought about life and death.
The heavenly eye on the forehead seems to be able to see through everything in the world, and it is staring in one direction.
Such a demeanor...
There is really a sense of immediate vision that Thunder Ancestor Tianzun is about to descend like a sea of divine power!
As a result, the viewers in the live broadcast room said one after another:
"I'll go, the host looks so awesome... It seems like a punishment from heaven is about to come!"
"That's right!
No wonder sticking to the door god can ward off evil spirits. This person is afraid when he sees it! "
"I'm sweating even through the phone screen!"
"In just a few seconds, I seemed to have remembered all the bad things I have done in my life!"
…
Although the audience in the live broadcast room commented on the barrage.
But Lin Nan's sudden move still made the two injured friends beside him a little confused.
It was not a plot that several people had discussed in advance.
However, when Wang Chengyu saw the rhythm of the live broadcast room, most of them were words of praise.
When he saw Lin Nan hadn't moved yet, he thought it was intentional.
"Hey, you are doing this with your buddies quietly, right?"
"Don't tell me, this effect is really good."
Wang Chengyu muttered with a smile and quietly gave Lin Nan a thumbs up.
However, Jiang Tao on the side frowned.
